config.inlineInstructions:
You read ONE Microsoft 365 Message Center post and decide which AI models used by Copilot Studio agents in this tenant it affects. You do NOT send emails - the workflow does that from your structured output. Use ONLY the post and the inventory summary. Never invent models, dates or replacements.

Today (UTC): @{utcNow('yyyy-MM-dd')}

Message Center post (JSON):
@{items('For_each_message')}

Inventory summary - one row per model + harness combination used by agents in this tenant (key, model, harness, count_ = number of agents):
@{coalesce(body('Get_model_summary')?['data'], json('[]'))}

Rules:
1. Read the WHOLE post body, including tables and lists. Find every model that is retired, reaches end of support, is deprecated, is automatically migrated/upgraded, or changes behavior. Ignore models that are only announced as new or newly available.
2. If the change only applies to prompts (AI Builder), Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat or other products - not to Copilot Studio agents - nothing is impacted.
3. Match affected models to inventory rows. Compare model names ignoring case, spaces, hyphens, dots and underscores ("GPT-5 Chat" = "gpt-5-chat" = "GPT5Chat"). Versions must match exactly: GPT-5 is NOT GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6 is NOT Claude Sonnet 4.5.
4. Harness: "Microsoft Copilot harness" or "GitHub Copilot harness" = harness "GitHub Copilot"; "standard harness" / "standard orchestration" = "Standard"; "classic" / "conversational" = "Conversational AI". If the post does not restrict the harness, include every harness row of that model. If you are not sure a row is affected, leave it out and mention it in reason.

Output:
- inventoryKeys: the `key` values of the matched inventory rows, copied EXACTLY, separated by ";;" (e.g. "GPT-5 Chat|Standard;;GPT-5 Chat|GitHub Copilot"). Empty string if nothing in the inventory is affected.
- impacts: one item per matched key: model, harness, change (Retirement, End of support, Deprecation, Automatic migration, Upgrade or Behavior change), replacement ("" if none), date (yyyy-MM-dd; if only a month is given use its first day; "" if none).
- actionBy: the earliest impacts date (yyyy-MM-dd), or "".
- headline: one plain-text sentence (max 300 characters) for agent owners explaining what changes and when.
- reason: one line explaining why agents are or are not affected (mention uncertain matches here).

config.markdown:
**CUSTOMIZE - Trigger**

Runs daily (Recurrence). If you change the frequency, set `lookbackDays` in *Config* to the same interval so no post is missed or processed twice. To test, use Test / Run now (temporarily raise `lookbackDays`, e.g. 30, to pick up recent posts).

**CUSTOMIZE - Configuration (fill in first)**

- `tenantId`, `clientId` - Entra app with Graph *ServiceMessage.Read.All* (application)
- `keyVaultSecretName` - Key Vault secret with that app's client secret
- `adminEmail` - governance mailbox: gets one summary per post and every email in test mode
- `contactText` - who owners should contact, shown in the owner email (default: your Power Platform environment admins)
- `lookbackDays` - must match the trigger interval
- `testMode` - **true** = owner emails go to `adminEmail` only (shows the real recipient), max `testModeMaxEmails` per post
- `maxOwnerEmailsPerPost` - safety cap on owner emails per post (the summary says when it was hit)
- `environmentIds` - **scope**: environment IDs to check, e.g. `["<env-id-1>", "<env-id-2>"]` (Power Platform admin center > Environments > Details). Leave `[]` for the whole tenant

**CUSTOMIZE - Model lifecycle filter**

*ModelServices*: Message Center services whose posts can affect Copilot Studio agents. A post reaches the agent only if it has one of these services AND its title mentions a model term (ai model, models, harness, gpt, claude, ...) or its body mentions retiring/replacement model. Each post that passes is one agent run (Copilot credits).

**CUSTOMIZE - Graph call**

Entra app registration with ServiceMessage.Read.All (application). Tenant and client id come from *Config*; the client secret is read from Azure Key Vault with secure inputs/outputs - rotate it in Key Vault, never paste it here. Paging is on.

**CUSTOMIZE - Connections (production)**

Key Vault, *Power Platform for Admins V2*, Office 365 Outlook and Users connections sign in as a user. If that sign-in expires or the user loses a role, runs fail (401/403). Use a dedicated service account (or for Key Vault a service principal / Secret environment variable) so runs don't depend on a person.

After assigning an admin role, **re-sign-in** the Admins V2 connection (Fix connection) - old tokens keep returning 403.

**CUSTOMIZE - Agent inventory**

*Query Power Platform resources* (Power Platform for Admins V2) reads the Power Platform inventory. The connection must be an OAuth (user) connection of a **Power Platform / Global administrator**.

*Get model summary* returns one row per `model` + `harness` (with agent count) - small enough for the agent even in tenants with thousands of agents. Agents on *Copilot Studio default* and *Microsoft 365 Copilot* are excluded (Microsoft moves them automatically). `properties.model` is a preview field and reflects the **published** agent.

**CUSTOMIZE - Agent (reasoning only)**

Reads the post (incl. tables), maps affected models + harness to the inventory summary (normalized names, exact versions, harness mapping: *Microsoft Copilot harness* = `GitHub Copilot`) and returns **structured output**: `inventoryKeys`, `impacts` (model, harness, change, replacement, date), `actionBy`, `headline`, `reason`. It sends nothing itself, so cost stays at one agent run per matching post no matter how many agents are impacted.

**Server-side queries**

*Get impacted agents* returns agents whose `model|harness` key the agent matched (first 1000 - the API page size; totals are always exact), used for the admin summary. Each owner's own list comes from *Get owner agents* inside the loop (up to 1000 per owner; if an owner has more, the email says so). *Get impacted owners* groups them by owner (no-owner rows excluded) and is capped by `maxOwnerEmailsPerPost` (or `testModeMaxEmails` in test mode).

**For each Message Center post**

Every post returned by the Graph call is checked here, one at a time. *Is it about AI model lifecycle?* applies the *ModelServices* + keyword filter; posts that don't match go to Else and nothing happens (no agent run, no cost).

**Any agents impacted?**

True when the agent returned at least one `inventoryKeys` value (a model + harness that exists in this tenant / scope). Otherwise the post doesn't affect any agent: Else, no emails.

**What changes table**

Turns the agent's `impacts` (model, harness, change, replacement, date) into the HTML table shown at the top of every owner email and in the admin summary - built once per post, reused for every owner.

**Per owner: their agents**

*Get owner agents* queries the inventory again for just this owner (same keys and scope), so owners aren't limited by the post-wide query (up to 1,000 agents per owner; above that the email says the list is partial). *Select* + *Create table* turn it into the agent / environment table at the end of the email.

**Get owner profile**

Looks up the owner's Entra object id (Office 365 Users) to get the name and email. If the user was deleted or can't be found the step fails, and the email goes to `adminEmail` with an *Owner not found* banner so someone can forward it.

**CUSTOMIZE - Owner email**

One email per owner per post (5 in parallel): what changes, what to do and the action-by date, then their agents (list last so long lists don't bury the actions; High importance within 30 days). Runs even if *Get owner profile* fails (configure run after).

**Sender**: the account of the *Office 365 Outlook* connection. To send from a shared mailbox instead, swap to *Send an email from a shared mailbox (V2)* - the connection user needs Send As on it.

**Admin summary**

Runs after all owner emails for the post. One email to `adminEmail`: scope, totals, whether the email cap was hit, the *What changes* table and the first 500 impacted agents (incl. agents without an owner, who get no email). Sent from the same *Office 365 Outlook* connection.
